findings.summary: execute argument.token is enforced only in validateNextTransition semantics, with no test for missing/empty/whitespace token; JSON Schema items require only name.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Add RED→GREEN tests for execute args missing token and whitespace-only token that fail until the semantic guard rejects them; keep REQ-transition-surface-parity-002 covered by runtime tests.

findings.summary: validate()/validateInstance treats non-object schemas (null, undefined, false, non-object) as valid:true; boolean false should reject-all per Draft 2020-12.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Reject invalid/non-object schemas and treat schema===false as reject-all; add unit tests proving validateInstance(false|null|undefined|string, instance) is not falsely valid.

findings.summary: Unresolved local $ref error path in kernel-schema-validator has no unit test.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Add a test with $ref '#/$defs/missing' that asserts the unresolved $ref error rule.

findings.summary: k1-schema-compat parses doc-field-claims.json without try/catch; malformed claims crash the whole lint run.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Wrap claims read/parse in try/catch and emit a structured offender; add a corrupt-claims fixture test.

findings.summary: change-classification hard floors gate on truthy impact keys without requiring booleans.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Require boolean true for floor evidence keys (or explicitly document coercion) and add tests for non-boolean truthy values that must not raise floors incorrectly.

findings.summary: resolveAlias input TypeError for non-string/empty tag is untested.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Add tests for '', null, and non-string tags asserting fail-closed TypeError.

findings.summary: Module-level caches in kernel-aliases and next-transition never invalidate after first disk load.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Document process-lifetime cache assumption or add explicit invalidation/reload for long-lived harnesses.
